page.title: Company details
page.subtitle: The legal and tax details shown on the tax invoice
page.read_only: View only. Company details can be edited by the main company account only.
page.legal_name_placeholder: e.g. Ofuq Real Estate Co. Ltd.
page.slug_hint: Lowercase English letters, digits and hyphens, 3 to 40 characters. Used in your store link and your document links.
page.slug_replace: “{{old}}” will be replaced by “{{next}}”. The old name stays reserved and will not come back to you, because links published with it keep pointing to it.
page.slug_none: You have not chosen a subdomain yet. It is saved with “Save details”.
page.logo_hint: Shown on the printed tax invoice. Allowed types: PDF or an image (JPEG/PNG/WebP), up to 10 MB.
page.save_to_apply: Press “Save details” to apply the change.
page.lock_label: Lock properties and contracts: only the owner or an exempted employee can change them
page.lock_hint: When on, reading and reports stay the same for everyone; only adding, editing and deleting properties and contracts is blocked. Exempt a specific employee from the “Employee accounts” screen.
page.writeoff_label: Damaged stock write offs need two people: whoever records a write off cannot approve it
page.writeoff_hint: If you work alone, turn it off to approve what you record yourself. Every write off, who recorded it and who approved it stay in the damage report and the audit log.
page.vat_period_hint: The period is monthly for anyone whose taxable supplies exceeded SAR 40 million over twelve months, and quarterly otherwise. Moving between them happens by a ZATCA notice with an effective date, so declare here what ZATCA confirmed for you; the system never changes it by itself. The VAT return screen warns you if it measures your supplies above the limit.
page.email_hint: A password reset link is sent to this address, so it can be replaced but not left empty.
page.current_password_hint: Changing the email needs your current password. A notice goes to the previous address.
page.address_hint: Shown on printed documents. E-invoicing needs the address broken down in the fields below.
page.unit_number_hint: These two fields complete the Saudi national address (7 fields) required by ZATCA and Ejar.

zatca.title: E-invoicing (ZATCA)
zatca.intro: We handle all the technical side for you: generating the keys, requesting the certificates and storing them encrypted. The only step needed from you is entering the verification code (OTP) from your company's Fatoora portal.
zatca.profile_incomplete: Complete the legal name and VAT number above first. The certificate is issued in your company's name and VAT number.
zatca.step_keys: 1. Generate the company keys and the signing request
zatca.otp_label: Verification code from the Fatoora portal
zatca.unreported_title: Issued, not delivered to ZATCA: {{n}} documents
zatca.unreported_failed: · {{n}} in the queue ran out of retries and resume once connected
zatca.unreported_linked: The company is connected, so each document here is a breach to put right by reporting it. Sending is retried automatically, and anything rejected is corrected and sent again.
zatca.unreported_unlinked: The company is not connected yet. These documents will not reach ZATCA until it is; once connected, they all go back to sending automatically.
zatca.incidents_hint: An incident is inferred from the ring times of sales that were synced more than the separation threshold after they were rung up: an inference, not a measurement from the device. The company keeps them because ZATCA requires records to be kept when the solution is down, and may ask about them.
